lesson_title: LESSON 07: Sharing the Road & Special Circumstances
topic_title: Transporting Cargo, Safety Chains & Towing Laws
prompt: What does Texas law require when transporting loose materials like sand, dirt, or gravel?

options.text: Cargo may be left uncovered provided the truck travels under forty mph
Must be covered with a secure canvas tarp or closed container to prevent blowing
Truck must stop every ten miles to manually shovel loose gravel into center
Covering is required only during nighttime hours between sunset and sunrise
